title: New hospital building, Brisbane: medical gases
workplace: New 10 storey hospital building with a two level basement and rooftop helipad, on an existing hospital campus next to the live hospital, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Medical gas pipework
swms.task: Install and braze the copper medical gas pipework for oxygen, medical air and suction in the ward ceilings and risers, from scissor lifts more than 2 m above the floor.

facts.fallControl: Scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m, and platform ladders only for work below 2 m.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.hotWorkPermit: The principal contractor issues a hot work permit each day, after checking the hospital's smoke detection is isolated only for the work area. A fire extinguisher is kept at each work area, and the area is checked 60 minutes after hot work ends.

missing: Hot work permit and fire watch

swms.title: Testing and connection to the live medical gas mains
swms.task: Pressure test the new medical gas pipework and connect it to the live oxygen and medical air mains in the existing hospital.

facts.serviceShutdown: Each connection is done under the hospital's shutdown permit SP-14, approved by hospital engineering, in the agreed window of 10 pm to 4 am. The ward and clinical staff are told beforehand, and cylinder supply set up by the medical gas supplier keeps patients supplied.
facts.pressureTesting: Tested with oxygen-free nitrogen to 1,400 kPa, pressurised in stages, with the area barricaded and signed during the test, and pressure released before any fitting is touched.

steps: Test and connect to live medical gas services
Work next to the live hospital

swms.title: Gas cylinder manifold room
swms.task: Install the medical gas manifold and move the gas cylinders into the manifold room.

rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 51, s 52, schedule 19
rules.quote: safe oxygen level means a minimum oxygen content in air of 19·5% by volume ... and a maximum oxygen content of air of 23·5% by volume

rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 53
